scenarios.name: two-banding-creatures-form-a-band-blocked-as-a-group
scenarios.why: Oracle: any creatures with banding can attack in a band. Kjeldoran Warrior and Benalish Hero (both 1/1, banding) attack as a band; Hill Giant (3/3) blocks only the Warrior, and so blocks the Hero too (702.22h). The attacking player p0 divides the Giant's 3 damage (702.22k) and puts all 3 on the Warrior: the Warrior dies, the Hero takes none. The two attackers deal 2 damage to the Giant, which lives, and p1 loses no life.

pick: 3 to Kjeldoran Warrior,0 to Benalish Hero

scenarios.name: band-needs-banding-and-at-most-one-plain-creature
scenarios.why: A band is any number of attacking creatures with banding and up to one without (702.22c). Kjeldoran Warrior (banding), Grizzly Bears and Hill Giant (neither has banding) attack; the Warrior takes the Bears into its band, which is then full of non-banding creatures, so the Giant attacks alone. p1's Grizzly Bears block the Warrior and so block p0's Bears too (702.22h); the attacking player p0 divides the blocker's 2 damage (702.22k) and puts it on the Warrior, which dies while p0's Bears take none. The Giant is unblocked: p1 loses 3.

pick: 2 to Kjeldoran Warrior,0 to Grizzly Bears
